instruction: Insert a page break before the paragraph that starts with 'Examples of introductory graphemes:'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(2);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting a page break before a specific paragraph. Evaluator checks if the target paragraph has a page break before it by checking the paragraph's page_break_before property.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic error at docs.py:36-37: run._element.get_or_add_br() is a mutating operation that ADDS a break element if absent, causing the check to always return True and potentially modify the document
The fallback page break detection (lines 34-37) will always succeed regardless of whether an actual page break exists
Primary check using para.paragraph_format.page_break_before is correct but the broken fallback undermines reliability
May not detect manual page breaks inserted via Ctrl+Return (distinct from page_break_before formatting property)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove lines 34-37 entirely - the get_or_add_br() logic is fundamentally flawed and unnecessary
Keep only the page_break_before check (line 31-32) which is the correct approach for this task
If manual page break detection is needed, use read-only XPath: run._element.xpath('.//w:br[@w:type="page"]')
Consider checking if previous paragraph ends with a page break as an alternative verification method
